content.comment_body: Hello. I'm looking for assistance. I'm trying to use a 'soft switch' in my application as a normally open momentary push button. However, when I provide an enable signal to 'EN', the output doesn't change to 1. I've reviewed the help documentation for the switch, but it's still unclear why the output won't change.

Hello [user_name], The Softkey function block is intended to be used with [product_name] operator interfaces or display devices. Please refer to the attached file for more details. Hope this is helpful.
Thanks for clarifying. I was implementing it in my program without the dedicated display, just using another input.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unable to get the 'soft switch' to work as a momentary push button because this feature is designed for use with specific operator interface hardware, not with arbitrary inputs. The available product documentation did not sufficiently clarify this limitation, leading to confusion for the user.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to configure and utilize a 'soft switch' as a momentary button using any general input, and is seeking clear guidance and documentation to facilitate this setup.
